title: The company we keep. Using hemodialysis social network data to classify patients' kidney transplant attitudes with machine learning algorithms.
summary: Among 110 hemodialysis patients in two clinics, logistic-regression ML using clinic social-network data classified transplant attitudes more accurately than sociodemographic/clinical features alone (accuracy 65% vs 61%; combined data 74%). This is a small cross-sectional behavioral result. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
